Infrastructure Engineer








Information Communications Technology - Port Moresby, NCD




 












Infrastructure Engineer


 


National Banking Corporation Limited (NBCL) is seeking a qualified and experienced Infrastructure Engineer to join our Information Technology team. This role is responsible for the implementation, administration, maintenance, monitoring, and support of the Bank’s infrastructure platforms and services, ensuring a secure, resilient, scalable, and highly available technology environment.


 


Reporting to the Infrastructure Manager, the successful candidate will play a key role in delivering and supporting enterprise infrastructure across both on-premises and cloud environments. The position is responsible for managing server platforms, operating systems, virtualization technologies, storage solutions, backup and recovery systems, cloud services, workplace technologies, and data centre operations.


As a critical member of the Technology team, the Infrastructure Engineer will ensure infrastructure services effectively support the Bank’s operational requirements, digital transformation initiatives, business continuity objectives, and regulatory obligations. The role will also contribute to infrastructure modernisation, performance optimisation, security enhancement, and the continuous improvement of technology services across the organisation.


 


Key Responsibilities




Implement, administer, and maintain enterprise infrastructure platforms and services.


Monitor infrastructure performance, availability, capacity, and security to ensure optimal service delivery.


Manage and support server environments, operating systems, virtualization platforms, and storage infrastructure.


Administer backup, recovery, and disaster recovery solutions to support business continuity requirements.


Support cloud infrastructure and services, ensuring secure and efficient integration with on-premises systems.


Manage workplace technologies and end-user infrastructure to enable a productive and secure working environment.


Maintain data centre operations and ensure infrastructure adheres to operational and security standards.


Troubleshoot and resolve infrastructure-related incidents, problems, and service requests.


Collaborate with vendors, service providers, and internal stakeholders to deliver reliable technology solutions.


Contribute to infrastructure enhancement projects, technology upgrades, and digital transformation initiatives.


Maintain accurate technical documentation, configurations, procedures, and operational records.




 


What We Are Looking For


The ideal candidate will possess strong technical expertise in enterprise infrastructure technologies, a proactive approach to problem-solving, and a commitment to delivering secure, reliable, and high-performing technology services. Experience within a regulated or financial services environment will be highly regarded.


This is an exciting opportunity to be part of a dynamic team driving innovation and operational excellence, while supporting the technology foundations that enable the Bank’s continued growth and success.











    	        
Apply

29040.description:
Practical – Accountable – Safety-Focused




 


As Operations Manager for Sarens in Papua New Guinea, you’ll lead the Operations Department and take ownership of equipment, projects and people. You’ll turn planning into safe, efficient execution while keeping a firm grip on costs and operational performance. Reporting to the Country Manager, you’ll work closely with the local management team and ensure our operations meet Sarens’ SHEQ standards. It’s a hands-on leadership role where your decisions have a direct impact on safety, service and profitability.


 


Join the force behind #NOTHING TOO HEAVY, NOTHING TOO HIGH


 


Your job in a nutshell:




Lead the planning and allocation of equipment and people across projects.


Monitor SHEQ compliance and drive safe working practices across all sites.


Set clear KPIs for direct reports and create accountability for results.


Prepare and manage the department’s annual operational budget.


Track project status, site execution and overtime against operational targets.


Control costs and working capital to protect profitability.


Deliver accurate operational performance reporting to Group management.


Recruit, coach and develop direct reports and people in key operational positions.


Report to the Country Manager and work closely with the local management team.






ABOUT YOU


You know how to turn complex operational demands into 
safe, practical and profitable results
. You bring hands-on experience from the 
heavy lift or crane rental industry
, understand the importance of 
SHEQ compliance
, and can balance equipment, people, budgets and project demands. Just as importantly, you lead with clarity: setting expectations, developing people and taking ownership when challenges arise.


 


What you’ll bring:




Experience managing operations in the heavy lift or crane rental industry.


Strong understanding of SHEQ standards and compliance requirements.


Proven ability to manage budgets, costs and P&L responsibility.


Experience leading and developing teams, including supervisors and planners.


Good reporting skills using ERP or similar systems.


Experience working within a multinational organisation.


Familiarity with Sarens project management methodology.


A background in procurement or supply chain coordination.






YOU GIVE SOME, YOU GET SOME


This role offers 
K70,000–K80,000 per annum
, alongside practical benefits designed to help you work safely and keep developing your career.


You’ll receive:




Paid training, tickets and licence upgrades.


Company-supplied PPE and uniform.


Employee Assistance Program support for you and your family.


Reward and recognition through our framework, including Safety Champions.


Career pathways across a global business.




About Sarens


Sarens is a global leader in crane rental, heavy lifting and engineered transport. For over a century, we have built our reputation by solving lifting and transport challenges others walk away from. Our philosophy is simple: 
Nothing Too Heavy, Nothing Too High.


 


Our people contribute to demanding projects across mining, oil and gas, energy, infrastructure and construction. In Oceania, we operate across Australia, Papua New Guinea and New Caledonia, supported by a global organisation that shares engineering expertise, equipment and knowledge across borders.


 


Our five values guide how we work: 
Brilliant Solutions, Love for Tradition, Dedication to Safety, Global Spirit and Zeal for Excellence.


 


Ready to join Team Blue? Own Your Future and rise to every challenge.


 


Sarens is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from Papua New Guinean citizens and encourage women to apply, including for technical and trade roles.







    	        
Apply

Own network architecture, security and NOC performance
Hands-on Cisco/Fortinet expertise essential
Lead and mentor a 24/7 network operations team
About the Company 
Our client provides digital banking services across Papua New Guinea, supporting mobile and internet banking, USSD, agency banking and electronic payment channels.
 
About the Role   
 Reporting to the Head of IT, the Senior Manager, Network Infrastructure will oversee the bank’s network architecture, security, performance and resilience.
 This hands-on leadership role requires someone who can independently design and implement network solutions, lead complex infrastructure projects and provide technical direction to engineers. You will develop local technical capability and lead the Network Operations Centre (NOC), ensuring secure and reliable services in a 24/7/365 environment.
 environment.
Key Responsibilities
 
 
Own network architecture, solution design and technical standards across LAN, WAN and digital banking infrastructure.
 
Design and implement network solutions and lead projects from planning through deployment and testing.
 
Provide hands-on technical guidance and work alongside engineers to resolve complex issues.
 
Mentor local engineers and strengthen internal technical capability through knowledge transfer.
 
Lead NOC operations, network monitoring, incident management and service availability.
 
Implement network security controls, including firewalls, DDoS mitigation and security monitoring.
 
Manage network capacity, redundancy, disaster recovery, business continuity and failover testing.
 
Ensure reliable performance across digital banking channels and ATM/POS payment networks.
 
Lead infrastructure improvements and manage technology vendors, telecommunications providers, service-level agreements and budgets.
 
Maintain network documentation, regulatory compliance and operational reporting, while leading the network engineering and operations team, including 24/7 coverage.
 
 
Skills and Experience
 
 
Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, Telecommunications or a related discipline.
 
8–10+ years in network engineering, including 3–5 years in senior technical leadership with direct infrastructure ownership.
 
Strong, current hands-on Cisco and Fortinet expertise across network design, routing, switching, firewalls and troubleshooting.
 
Proven ability to independently design and implement complex network solutions and lead projects from design through deployment.
 
Ability to provide technical direction, mentor engineers and develop local technical capability.
 
Experience managing secure, highly available infrastructure in 24/7 environments, including network security, DDoS mitigation, SIEM and disaster recovery.
 
Banking, financial services or payment systems experience, with knowledge of Central Bank requirements, PCI-DSS and ISO 27001.
 
Strong technical leadership, problem-solving and stakeholder management skills.
 
 
Certifications such as CCNP, CCIE, JNCIP, ITIL, CISSP or CISM are highly regarded. A Master’s degree is advantageous.
 
 This is a senior, high-impact role for a network leader ready to take true ownership of a bank's digital infrastructure — shaping strategy, leading a 24/7 team, and directly protecting the customer experience across every digital channel.





    	        
Apply

29034.description:
Executive leadership seat with direct influence on organisational strategy
Lead HR's digital future with AI, automation and modern HR technology
Join a trusted, values-driven PNG institution that invests in its people
About the Organisation
 Our client is a long-established and highly respected Papua New Guinean financial services organisation with a proud history of serving members and customers across the country. Built on trust, integrity and a deep commitment to the communities it serves, the organisation is now entering an exciting new chapter of growth and transformation, modernising how it operates, how it serves its customers and how it supports its people.
 Joining this organisation means becoming part of a values-driven business that genuinely invests in its workforce. You can expect a seat at the executive table, the backing of a leadership team that sees people as central to its success, and the rare opportunity to leave a lasting mark on a national institution. This is a role where your ideas will be heard, your leadership will be visible, and your impact will be felt across the entire organisation.
 
About the Role
 This is a unique opportunity for an experienced, forward-thinking people leader to take the helm of People & Culture during a significant period of organisational change. As Head of People & Culture, you will set the people strategy and lead all HR functions, including workforce planning, talent management, employee relations, learning and development, culture and organisational effectiveness.
 Above all, you will be the architect of a modern People & Culture function. You will lead the digitalisation of HR services, introduce AI, automation and contemporary HR technology, streamline processes and guide the organisation through a comprehensive change management programme, building a high-performing, engaged and values-driven workforce along the way.
 
Key Responsibilities
 
 
Develop and deliver a People & Culture strategy that drives business performance, acting as a trusted advisor to the CEO and Executive Leadership Team
 
Lead the digital transformation of HR, implementing AI, automation and modern HRIS platforms to improve service delivery and decision-making
 
Drive workforce planning, succession planning and talent pipeline development to attract, develop and retain top talent
 
Champion culture, values and employee engagement, leading culture transformation and change initiatives across the organisation
 
Provide oversight of complex employee relations matters and ensure full compliance with employment legislation, governance standards and audit requirements
 
Oversee performance management frameworks and support organisational design and restructuring initiatives
 
Shape learning and development strategy so capability building aligns with current business needs and future skills
 
Ensure efficient HR operations across recruitment, payroll interface, HR data and reporting
 
Lead, coach and develop a capable P&C team, including the Advisor, P&C Officer and Payroll team
 
 
About You
 
 
Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration or a related field; a postgraduate qualification or HR certification is highly regarded
 
10+ years of progressive HR experience, including at least 5 years in a senior leadership role
 
Demonstrated, hands-on experience implementing AI, automation and modern HR technologies
 
Proven track record in HR strategy, business partnering, organisational development and change management
 
Strong background in employee relations and talent management, with sound knowledge of employment legislation and best-practice HR frameworks
 
Confident using HR analytics and data to inform decisions
 
Exceptional stakeholder engagement, communication and influencing skills at executive and board level
 
A leader of high integrity who is strategic, commercially minded, resilient and genuinely passionate about people and culture
 
 
Why Apply?
 This is not a role for maintaining the status quo. It is a chance to transform an established organisation from the inside, modernise a function and build a legacy of capability and culture that will outlast your tenure. If you are energised by change, inspired by technology and driven to bring out the best in people, this is your next career-defining move.

29033.description:
At Newmont, we’re not just a world-leading gold and metals producer – we’re a team united by our commitment to shaping a more inclusive, sustainable, and responsible mining industry. Joining us means becoming part of a global, diverse workforce where everyone is valued, empowered, and encouraged to grow. Our people are the heart of our success, bringing exceptional skill, integrity, and dedication to everything we do as an organization and we’re dedicated to creating a workplace where everyone can thrive.


 


About Lihir


 


Our Lihir Operation, located on the beautiful island of Niolam, approximately 800km north of Papua New Guinea's capital, Port Moresby, is one of the world’s largest gold mines. Set within a geothermically active, extinct volcanic crater, Lihir operates an open-pit mine producing refractory ore, which undergoes pressure oxidation and conventional leaching to recover gold. Our workforce includes both residential and commute rosters, creating a diverse and dynamic team. Lihir offers a range of recreational facilities, including a gym, sports club, restaurant, bar, swimming pool, tennis and squash courts, and a 9-hole golf course. For those who enjoy the outdoors, the Lihir fishing and boating clubs provide access to pristine waters and beaches, while our onsite deli and café serve fresh local and imported produce, barista-made coffee, and freshly baked goods.


 


We are proud to work closely with the local Lihirian community and value its vibrant culture. Through initiatives like our School to Mine program, we offer meaningful employment, training, and development opportunities for Lihirian men and women, as well as scholarships and vocational apprenticeships. We also partner with the New Ireland Province to ensure economic benefits flow directly to the community, strengthening our commitment to sustainable development and positive local impact.


 


Purpose


The 
Electrical Engineer
 is responsible for providing minor electrical design and modifications within the process plant and associated mine site infrastructure that shall meet company specifications, comply with operational requirements, agreements and relevant standards. 


 


Essential Duties




Efficiently manage minor to medium projects to ensure they are completed as per agreed schedule, on budget and as per quality standards.


Review and investigate proposed electrical design within the plant and other mine site infrastructure and provide engineering guidance.


Complete engineering scope of works, develop design concepts, complete design and review drawings to ensure compliance with design scope and relevant standards.


Conduct load and cable calculations to ensure design is suitable for application.


Ensure all engineering activities meet the company’s business needs and consistently maintain high standards of occupational health, safety and environment.


Inspect completed installations and observe operations to ensure conformance to design and equipment specification and compliance with operational safety standards.


Effectively communicate day-to-day issues with the engineering teams and other work groups to develop good working relationships and report regularly on projects progress.


Recommend solutions to address issues that arise during construction work.




Training & Experience




Bachelor’s Degree qualification in Electrical Engineering


Registered with IEPNG


Valid Class 6 Driving License


Demonstrated experience in electrical engineering in a mining industry environment.


Demonstrated competence in the application of Australian Standards in electrical design.


Strong technical capability in power systems and industrial instrumentation.


Experience in the use of PowerPac Software.


Strong capability to perform relevant engineering calculations to support designs.


Able to read, understand and prepare engineering drawings.


Capability to review engineering drawings and red-line in consultation with the design team to ensure accurate design and construction drawings.


Strong attention to detail and documentation capability.


Excellent communication skills and ability to work with minimal supervision.


Good computer literacy and understanding of Microsoft software suite.


Understanding of safety compliance and regulations.




Working Conditions


This is a FIFO role on a 21/21 roster.


 


At Newmont, our commitment to diversity and inclusion ensures that everyone can work to their full potential, free from discrimination, while respecting the cultures, religions, and governance of the regions in which we operate. Guided by our values of Safety, Integrity, Sustainability, Responsibility, and Inclusion, our Lihir team – 90% of which are Papua New Guinean – is dedicated to creating a culturally rich and supportive environment where meaningful, long-term connections can be formed within the industry.


 


We believe in the strength of our people and the positive impact we can create together. Newmont employees are rewarded with a competitive salary, flexible packaging options, and programs that recognize those who go above and beyond. We know no candidate meets every qualification listed, so if you share our values and feel you can make a meaningful contribution, we encourage you to apply – we’d love to hear from you!





    	        
Apply

Join Our Dynamic Team!


Purchasing Officer – Maintenance


About business


Quest Exploration Drilling (QED) Ltd is a leading provider of drilling services in Papua New Guinea and the Philippines. With over 45 years of experience, QED has established itself as an industry leader in the resources and energy sectors.


Our operations in Papua New Guinea involve a diverse team of over 300 staff, engaging with local communities and employing personnel from all regions of the country.


 


About the position


Quest Exploration Drilling (PNG) Ltd invites applications from suitably qualified and experienced individuals for the position of 
Purchasing Officer – Maintenance
. The Purchasing Officer - Maintenance will be responsible for providing purchasing, procurement, and administrative support to the Maintenance Department’s purchases. The role is critical in ensuring that maintenance parts, consumables, tools, and services are sourced, ordered, and delivered in a timely manner to support operational requirements. The position also assists with maintaining accurate purchasing records, tracking orders, supporting inventory coordination, and liaising with suppliers and internal stakeholders.


 


Position Vacant: 
Purchasing Officer – Maintenance


Location:
 Lae
Department:
 Maintenance 
Reports To:
 Snr Purchasing Officer - Maintenance


 


Key Purpose of the Role


The primary purpose of this role is to support the efficient operation of the Maintenance Department by coordinating purchasing activities and ensuring the timely availability of required maintenance materials and services. The role contributes to minimizing downtime, maintaining purchasing accuracy, and supporting cost-effective procurement practices in line with company procedures.


Key Responsibilities




Raise purchase requisitions and purchase orders for maintenance-related parts, materials, consumables, and services


Obtain supplier quotations and assist with cost comparisons for purchasing decisions


Follow up outstanding orders and ensure timely delivery of required items


Liaise with suppliers, warehouse personnel, accounts, and maintenance staff on procurement matters

Provide day-to-day administrative support to the Maintenance Department


Ensure all purchasing activities are carried out in accordance with company policies, procedures, and approval authorities

Previous experience in a drilling, mining, construction, transport, heavy equipment, or similar operational environment

Good understanding of purchasing processes, supplier coordination, and stock control


Strong administrative and organizational skills with a high level of attention to detail


Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple priorities within required timeframes


Good communication and interpersonal skills

A reliable, proactive, and solutions-focused approach to work




 


Qualifications




Certificate, Diploma, or relevant qualification in Procurement, Business Administration, Logistics, Supply Chain, or a related field will be an advantage

The Institute of Business Studies (IBS), from its’ humble beginning in 1987 as an arm of Nades & Associates primarily providing revision classes for the needs of Papua New Guinea Institute of Accountants (now CPA PNG), has evolved into a private University level Institution over the last 38 years. Today we are one of the largest business schools in the country and off degree programmes in the fields of Accounting & Finance, Business & Management, Economics & Development Studies and Information Technology. We also continue to provide study pathways for grade 10 & 12 school leavers including industry accreditations for those seasoned professionals who want to get certified in their field.


 


Our success is the fruits of our dedicated team committed to making a difference in Papua New Guinea, through their efforts to help educate current and futures citizens on Papua New Guinea.


 


A Career with Us:


At IBS we believe that everyone has been gifted with natural talents and learnt skills. Our recruitment process is designed to help candidates understand this and enable us to better match you with a role that you will not only be able to do but enjoy doing. Career progression is also important to us and believes that each employee should be at the driving seat of their career progression - this means your manager will discuss with you where you want to be in the future and be more of a coach for you in terms of giving you feedback on areas you need to work on to be your best and achieve your goals. We also have a lot of staff events that enable us to celebrate as a team and give recognition where it's due.


 


Primary Responsibility         




Managing a team of QA Officers and Analysts, coordinating testing activities across projects, liaising with other departments, providing technical guidance, and ensuring quality standards are met.




 


Key Responsibilities      




Manage the day-to-day work of Level 3 and Level 4 staff (Officers and Analysts).


Coordinate the execution of internal audits, operational reviews, and compliance checks.


Ensure the team follows the established QA framework and standards.


Contribute to the compilation of Quality Assurance reports.




 


Qualifications


A degree or equivalent in the relevant discipline.




Professional Qualification (Or reaching the final level) in Accounting, Auditing, Risk Management, Compliance, or any other relevant field.


Two to Three Years' Experience in Risk Management, Auditing, Compliance, Education Administration, or any similar relevant field.




 


Career Progression    




Upward movement to Quality Assurance Manager (Level 1) shall take place after 4-6 years of experience, with a proven track record of leadership and successful project delivery.

About Drillcube


Drillcube is an Australian-owned mining services company operating worldwide. We provide high-quality underground mining consumables at competitive prices, helping mining operations improve efficiency and productivity.


 


Position Overview


The Drill Bit Rig Technician manages the collection, inspection, replenishment, and inventory of drilling consumables across underground mining operations. The role supports daily rig servicing, drill bit refurbishment, quality control, and safe, efficient service delivery.


 


Key Responsibilities




Collect used drill bits and replenish consumables at underground drill rigs daily.


Complete rig servicing records and track consumable movements.


Deliver worn drill bits for sharpening and return refurbished stock to the rigs.


Monitor inventory levels, storage, and stock identification.


Identify wear patterns, equipment issues, and opportunities to improve drilling performance.


Maintain and inspect service vehicles, tools, and equipment.


Follow site safety procedures, use required PPE and maintain housekeeping standards.


Comply with mining regulations and environmental requirements.




 


Essential Requirements




Previous experience in an underground mining environment.


Understanding of underground drilling equipment and consumables.


Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.


Strong attention to detail and a customer-focused attitude.


Current driver's license.


Ability to perform manual handling tasks and work underground in confined spaces.


Flexibility to work rotating rosters and shifts.




 


Desirable Qualifications




Certificate II or III in Engineering, Mechanical, or a related trade.


Previous drilling experience.


Current First Aid certificate.


Forklift license, underground mining inductions, and relevant site competencies or statutory certifications.




 


Key Knowledge and Skills




Underground drilling methods and drill bit wear patterns.


Drill consumable maintenance and inventory management.


Mining safety procedures, manual handling, and equipment maintenance
.




 


Physical Requirements




Safely handle and lift drill steels and drill bits.


Work in confined underground environments and stand for extended periods.


Be available for rotating rosters and shifts.




 


Licenses and Certifications




Current driver's license.


Forklift license.


Underground mining inductions and site-specific competencies.


Statutory mining certifications required.

28942.description:
Job Type:
 
Permanent
 
About us 


K92 Mining Limited are the owners the high-grade Kainantu Gold Mine in Eastern Highlands Province. Since commencing operations in 2016, we have delivered consistent production growth. More importantly, we have contributed significantly to the economy of Papua New Guinea, more than 90% of our employees and contractors are from PNG and our local education and skills development initiatives which include scholarships, traineeships and adult literacy programs continue to bring significant benefit the communities in which we operate. 


We are now transforming the operation with a new 1.2 mtpa process plant as well as extensive construction and expansion across site that will see us triple the output from our mine by 2027. In addition to our ongoing production success, we have an extensive exploration programme across our highly prospective tenement, making K92 a great place to build a long-term career.


About the role


Joining our APD team, you will work coordinate a team of APD officers to ensure the safety of our growing gold site in the Eastern Highlands. In this role you will assist with the development of operational security systems, develop standard operating procedures, and provide training in security emergency related preparedness


Key Accountabilities




Proactively engage with the APD Supervisors to provide security advice and support to the APD Teams to ensure APD fleet availability and security targets are achieved and optimised against budget.


Respond to routine and emergency calls for security /or support within the mine site area, underground or in the field as required to ensure security on equipment and people`s life is minimised.


Perform troubleshooting to identify and remedy issues that may arise.


Support and assist the APD team to ensure the rectification of identified defect equipment to improve and optimise availability and reliability targets.


Work closely with the Superintendent APD to assess performance and identify improvement projects to maximise results, reduce risk and implement cost management initiatives.


Maintain the Gold Room security system and ensure that the contract between the owners and contractors relating to the movement of gold, is carried out in accordance with K92 Mining Limited`s procedures.


Establish a high-performance culture by motivating team members to achieve a high level of performance and by rewarding and recognising high performance.


Appraise and evaluate direct reports in accordance with K92 Mining Limited ’s Work Performance systems   process by providing individual performance feedback, giving guidance and direction, and developing and agreeing on improvement plans


Ensure effective processes for communicating relevant information, including company, site, department, and team performance, to all team members are in place.


Direct and train employees on the APD process, procedure, and Equipment.


Continuously mentor and coach technicians on effective repair techniques.


Identify skills gaps and training requirements and assist in developing training packages as required to close the skills gap.


Actively review the work performance of APD Supervisors and provide feedback to the APD Superintendent including the talent and succession planning for designated key roles.


Actively promotes a safe and healthy culture.


Demonstrates personal responsibility for own health and safety whilst setting clear expectations of relevant legal obligations, safe workplace practices and HSE operating practices to others, holding them accountable for their actions.


Perform general housekeeping within and around responsible work area.




About You 


To be considered for this role, you will require a minimum level of Grade 10 education and a minimum of 5 years’ experience in mining and fire & emergency response disciplines.




Successful completion of accredited safety, fire, and emergency response training.


Competent in breathing apparatus, rescue from height, confined space rescue and fire response.


Experience in fire suppression equipment maintenance.


Current Occupational First Aid Certificate.


Good written and oral communication skills in English and Pidgin.


Ability to write reports and have good computer skills in Word & Excel.


Proven man management and supervisory skills.


Good, demonstrated skills in Radio / telephone procedures.


Sound incident investigation skills.


Truck driving license.


Sound planning, analytical and problem-solving skills.


Excellent trouble shooting skills.


Self-motivated with the ability to work under pressure and autonomously.


Excellent attention to detail and time management skills to meet deadlines.


Strong active listening & interpersonal skills for rapport building, conflict resolution & training.




Life at K92  


K92 is an Equal Opportunity Employer, our commitment is to respect the rights of every individual to work to their highest potential, free from discrimination.  Our values of Collaboration, Accountability, Respect for others, Excellence and Safety are at the core of everything we do, and they are the foundation upon which our success has been built.


Our camp is well managed and provides residents with good, healthy meals made from locally sourced fresh produce as well as internet, cable tv and a gymnasium.


At K92, we want all employees to share in our success, so as well as a competitive salary, employees also participate in our long- and short-term incentive plans, we also provide employees with access to savings incentive programs, medical assistance and the option to salary sacrifice for certain expenses.


In addition to all of this, employees can also access our Wellbeing and employee assistance programs whilst working a friendly roster. 


THIS POSITION IS OPEN ONLY TO CANDIDATES WHO HAVE THE RIGHT TO LIVE & WORK IN PNG WITHOUT SPONSORSHIP 





    	        
Apply

28856.description:
Job Description - HVAC Tradesman


 
Position Summary


The HVAC Tradesman is responsible for the installation, servicing, preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of air-conditioning, refrigeration, and ventilation systems. The role ensures that assigned work is completed safely, efficiently, and to an acceptable technical standard while minimizing equipment downtime and repeat call-backs.


 




 Key Responsibilities


 Installation and Commissioning






Install split, ducted, cassette, package, and other commercial air-conditioning systems.


Install refrigerant pipework, condensate drains, ducting, electrical control wiring, and associated HVAC components.


Carry out pressure testing, vacuuming, refrigerant charging, testing, and commissioning.


Follow approved drawings, manufacturer specifications, and installation requirements.


Ensure installations are neat, secure, properly supported, and completed to an acceptable workmanship standard.






 Preventive Maintenance






Carry out scheduled preventive maintenance on HVAC and refrigeration equipment.


Inspect and clean filters, coils, drain systems, fans, blowers, and other components.


Check refrigerant condition, operating pressures, temperatures, electrical connections, motors, capacitors, contactors, and controls.


Identify developing faults during maintenance and report them before they result in equipment failure.


Complete maintenance checklists and service reports accurately.




 




 Troubleshooting and Repair






Diagnose mechanical, refrigeration, electrical, and control faults systematically.


Carry out appropriate testing before recommending replacement of components.


Repair or replace defective compressors, fan motors, capacitors, contactors, thermostats, sensors, control boards, valves, and other HVAC components as required.


Perform leak detection, refrigerant recovery, evacuation, charging, and system performance testing.


Verify that equipment is operating correctly before leaving the job site.


Avoid unnecessary replacement of parts and minimize repeat call-backs through accurate diagnosis and quality workmanship.






 Electrical and Controls






Perform basic electrical troubleshooting associated with HVAC equipment.


Check voltage, current, continuity, resistance, insulation, and equipment electrical connections using appropriate test instruments.


Interpret basic electrical wiring and control diagrams.


Identify electrical faults and escalate work outside the employee's competency or authorization.


Work Planning and Productivity


Review assigned jobs and ensure required tools, materials, equipment, and spare parts are available before commencing work.


Complete assigned work within reasonable timeframes.


Inform the supervisor promptly of delays, additional work, material requirements, or technical issues.


Take proper care of company tools, equipment, vehicles, and materials.


Minimize wastage and use company resources responsibly.






 Safety Responsibilities






Follow company WHS/OHS procedures and site safety requirements.


Use appropriate PPE at all times.


Carry out risk assessments or Job Safety Analysis where required.


Follow safe electrical isolation and lockout procedures.


Use ladders, scaffolding, power tools, and test equipment safely.


Handle refrigerants and compressed gases safely and responsibly.


Maintain a clean and safe working area.


Immediately report hazards, incidents, injuries, and unsafe conditions.






 Documentation and Reporting






Complete service reports, maintenance sheets, time sheets, and other required documentation accurately.


Clearly record equipment faults, work performed, parts replaced, operating measurements, and recommendations.


Provide accurate information when additional repairs or quotations are required.


Report technical issues to the supervisor when the fault is beyond the Tradesman's level of competency.


Maintain proper records of refrigerant usage where required.




 




 Customer Service and Conduct






Communicate professionally and respectfully with customers, supervisors, and other employees.


Explain technical findings clearly without providing misleading or unsupported information.


Maintain a professional appearance and acceptable workplace behaviour.


Respect customer property and maintain cleanliness at the work site.


Avoid making unauthorized commitments regarding pricing, additional work, or company obligations.


Maintain confidentiality regarding customer and company information.






 Skills and Competencies






Good knowledge of HVAC and refrigeration principles.


Sound mechanical and basic electrical troubleshooting skills.


Ability to use multimeters, clamp meters, manifold gauges, vacuum pumps, recovery equipment, and other HVAC tools.


Ability to read basic wiring diagrams and equipment technical information.


Systematic fault-finding and problem-solving ability.


Good workmanship and attention to detail.


Ability to work independently with appropriate supervision.


Good time management and job planning.


Clear verbal and written communication.


Ability to work effectively as part of a service team.


Willingness to learn and improve technical skills.






 Qualifications and Experience






Recognized trade qualification in Refrigeration and Air Conditioning, HVAC, or a related trade.


Relevant electrical competency or qualification where applicable.


Practical experience in commercial and/or residential air-conditioning and refrigeration.


Current driver's licence where driving company vehicles is required.


Relevant safety training and certifications.


Experience with VRF/VRV, package units, chilled-water systems, controls, or BMS systems would be an advantage.






 Performance Expectations






Technical competency


Quality of workmanship


Accuracy of fault diagnosis


Productivity and completion of assigned work


Number of avoidable repeat call-backs


Preventive maintenance quality


Safety compliance


Care and accountability for tools and materials


Accuracy and timeliness of job documentation


Attendance and punctuality


Communication and interpersonal skills


Customer service


Initiative and willingness to learn


Ability to follow instructions and procedures






 Key Accountability






The HVAC Tradesman is expected to take responsibility for the quality of his assigned work. Faults must be properly diagnosed and verified through appropriate testing before repairs or replacement of major components are recommended.


Where the technician is uncertain about a diagnosis or repair procedure, assistance must be sought from the Service Supervisor or National Service Manager before proceeding.






 Overall Standard






The HVAC Tradesman is expected to demonstrate safe work practices, sound technical judgment, good workmanship, productivity, professionalism, and continuous improvement. All work should be completed to company standards, manufacturer requirements, and applicable codes and regulations.




 
 
To Apply
To apply for this job simply click on the blue "Apply" button below.  If you prefer to use email instead, please send your CV and other relevant documentation to 
[email protected]
.  Please include the Job ID "
#28856
" in the email's subject to ensure your application is processed.





            

        
Apply

        

        
        

	        

	        Any sharing or copying and pasting of this content in other platforms must acknowledge PNGworkforce.com by mentioning the content is from PNGworkforce.com or by placing a link to PNGworkforce.com.

Job Description - HVAC-R Service Supervisor




 Position Summary




The HVAC-R Service Supervisor is responsible for supervising and coordinating the installation, servicing, maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of Heating, Ventilation, Air Conditioning and Refrigeration (HVAC-R) systems.


HVAC-R Service Supervisor ensures that all assigned work is performed safely, efficiently, professionally, and to the required technical and quality standards. The Supervisor is responsible for allocating work, monitoring technician performance, providing technical guidance, ensuring proper documentation, controlling materials and tools, and maintaining effective communication with clients and management.




 Key Responsibilities


 Supervision and Team Management






Supervise HVAC-R Tradesmen, Apprentices, Trade Assistants, and other assigned personnel.


Allocate daily work and clearly communicate job requirements, priorities, and expected completion times.


Conduct daily toolbox meetings and ensure workers understand the scope of work and associated hazards.


Monitor the progress and quality of work performed by technicians.


Ensure employees work according to their level of competency and authorization.


Provide technical guidance and practical assistance when technicians encounter difficult faults or installation issues.


Monitor employee attendance, punctuality, productivity, conduct, and overall work performance.


Identify skills gaps and recommend appropriate technical training or development.


Mentor apprentices and junior technicians to improve their technical competency.


Promote teamwork, discipline, accountability, and professional conduct within the service team.


Immediately report serious performance, disciplinary, safety, or competency concerns to the Technical Service Manager.




 




 HVAC-R Technical Responsibilities






Supervise installation, commissioning, maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of HVAC-R equipment.


Provide technical support for:




Split and multi-split air-conditioning systems.


Package air-conditioning units.


VRF/VRV systems.


Chilled-water systems.


Commercial refrigeration equipment.


Cold rooms and freezer rooms.


Ventilation and exhaust systems.


Control systems and associated electrical components.




Verify technicians follow correct troubleshooting procedures before recommending replacement of compressors, motors, PCBs, or other major components.


Review and confirm technical diagnoses where major equipment or component replacement is recommended.


Ensure electrical tests, pressure tests, leak tests, evacuation, refrigerant charging, temperature measurements, and operational tests are correctly performed.


Ensure refrigerant handling practices are carried out correctly and safely.


Ensure equipment is correctly commissioned before handover to the client.


Ensure recurring equipment failures are properly investigated and their root causes identified.


Escalate complex technical faults to the Technical Service Manager or relevant technical support personnel when required.






 Preventive Maintenance






Plan and coordinate scheduled preventive maintenance activities.


Ensure preventive maintenance is completed according to contractual requirements and maintenance schedules.


Check that technicians complete all required maintenance tasks and do not simply perform basic cleaning.


Verify operating conditions and record relevant parameters where applicable, including:




Operating pressures.


Voltage and current.


Temperature readings.


Compressor and fan operation.


Refrigerant condition.


Electrical connections.


Filters, coils and drainage systems.




Identify equipment requiring corrective maintenance and recommend appropriate action.


Monitor outstanding defects identified during preventive maintenance and ensure appropriate follow-up.




 




 Installation and Project Supervision






Review job scope, drawings, specifications, and site requirements before starting work.


Conduct or participate in site inspections where required.


Coordinate manpower, tools, equipment, and materials for installations.


Ensure equipment is installed according to manufacturer requirements, approved drawings, specifications, and good industry practice.


Check refrigerant piping, insulation, drainage, electrical connections, controls, mounting arrangements, and equipment locations.


Ensure pressure testing, evacuation, refrigerant charging, electrical testing, and commissioning are correctly carried out.


Identify site variations or additional work and report them to management before proceeding where approval is required.


Ensure completed installations are properly tested and commissioned before client handover.






 Quality Control






Inspect completed work to ensure workmanship meets company and client requirements.


Ensure technicians follow correct service and installation procedures.


Minimize repeat callouts caused by poor workmanship, incorrect diagnosis, or incomplete repairs.


Ensure faults are properly diagnosed before spare parts are requested.


Verify completion of corrective work before closing service jobs.


Conduct random quality inspections of technicians' work.


Investigate callbacks and identify corrective actions where workmanship deficiencies are identified.






 Safety Responsibilities






Ensure all HVAC-R work is performed according to company HSE requirements and applicable workplace safety requirements.


Conduct toolbox meetings and job hazard assessments before commencing higher-risk activities.


Ensure appropriate Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) is used.


Ensure safe practices are followed when working:




At heights.


With refrigerants.


With pressurized systems.


On electrical equipment.


With lifting equipment.


In confined or restricted areas.




Verify technicians isolate electrical supplies before carrying out applicable repair work.


Stop any unsafe work immediately and take appropriate corrective action.


Report workplace incidents, near misses, injuries, and unsafe conditions.


Ensure tools and test instruments are suitable and safe for use.






 Tools, Equipment and Materials






Ensure technicians are issued appropriate tools and equipment for assigned work.


Monitor proper use and care of company tools, ladders, test equipment, vacuum pumps, recovery equipment, and other assets.


Ensure test instruments are maintained and calibrated where required.


Ensure materials and spare parts issued for jobs are properly controlled.


Verify unused parts and materials are returned appropriately.


Minimize unnecessary material wastage.


Report damaged, lost, or defective tools and equipment.


Assist with identifying and ordering required spare parts and materials.






 Service Documentation and Reporting






Review technicians' service reports before job closure.


Ensure service reports clearly identify:




Customer complaint.


Equipment details.


Fault identified.


Tests conducted.


Work performed.


Parts and materials used.


Equipment operating condition.


Outstanding work or recommendations.




Ensure technicians provide appropriate photos and supporting information where required.


Prepare technical reports for significant equipment failures when requested.


Ensure timesheets, job sheets, maintenance checklists, and other service documents are completed accurately and submitted on time.


Provide management with regular updates on outstanding jobs, technical issues, manpower requirements, and customer concerns.






 Customer Service






Communicate professionally with clients and site representatives.


Explain technical problems and recommended corrective actions clearly.


Provide appropriate job status updates to customers.


Attend customer complaints professionally and escalate significant concerns to management.


Ensure technicians maintain professional behavior while working at customer premises.


Ensure work areas are left clean and safe upon job completion.


Maintain positive working relationships with customers without making unauthorized commercial commitments on behalf of the company.






 Work Planning and Coordination






Plan daily technician assignments according to priorities and available manpower.


Coordinate emergency breakdown calls and scheduled maintenance activities.


Ensure technicians receive necessary job information before deployment.


Monitor outstanding service calls and follow up until completion.


Coordinate with stores/procurement regarding spare parts and materials.


Communicate manpower shortages, equipment requirements, and operational issues to the Service Coordinator/Technical Service Manager.


Assist in improving service response times and technician productivity.






 Authority and Accountability






Allocate and supervise work within the assigned service team.


Stop work where an unsafe condition or unacceptable workmanship is identified.


Require corrective action when work does not meet company requirements.


Recommend further training where competency gaps are identified.


Escalate disciplinary and performance issues to management.


Verify technical findings before approving recommendations for major component replacement.


Ensure jobs are not reported as complete until required work, testing, documentation, and housekeeping have been completed.


Protect company tools, equipment, materials, vehicles, and other assets under their supervision.






 Technical Competencies






HVAC-R fault diagnosis and troubleshooting.


Electrical fault finding associated with HVAC-R systems.


Refrigerant pressure and temperature analysis.


Refrigerant recovery, evacuation, charging, and leak testing.


Compressor and motor electrical testing.


Reading electrical wiring diagrams and technical drawings.


Installation and commissioning procedures.


Preventive and corrective maintenance.


Use of multimeters, clamp meters, insulation resistance testers, vacuum gauges, manifolds, and other HVAC-R test instruments.


Preparing accurate service and technical reports.


Basic computer and email skills.


Understanding manufacturer service manuals and technical documentation.






 Supervisory and Behavioural
 
Competencies






Leadership and accountability.


Strong technical judgment.


Good planning and organizational skills.


Problem-solving ability.


Effective communication.


Professional customer service.


Teamwork and interpersonal skills.

28800.description:
Summary






The Genset Maintenance Technician is responsible for the preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, repair, and servicing of diesel and gas-powered generators across company facilities. This role ensures reliable backup power supply, compliance with safety standards, and optimal performance of all generator sets (gensets).


Duties and Responsibilities






1. Generator Maintenance & Servicing




Perform 
scheduled preventive maintenance
 (oil changes, filter replacements, coolant checks, battery testing).


Conduct 
load bank testing
 to verify generator performance under load.


Inspect and maintain 
fuel systems, cooling systems, exhaust systems, and electrical components
.




2. Troubleshooting & Repairs




Diagnose and repair 
mechanical failures
 (engine issues, fuel injectors, turbochargers, belts, pumps).


Troubleshoot 
electrical faults
 (AVR, control panels, wiring, circuit breakers, voltage regulators).


Replace defective parts and ensure proper reassembly and testing.




3. Emergency Response




Provide 
24/7 on-call support
 for generator failures and power outages.


Rapidly diagnose issues and implement corrective actions to minimize downtime.




4. Documentation & Compliance




Maintain detailed 
service logs, work orders, and maintenance records
 (CMMS or manual logs).


Ensure compliance with 
OSHA, NFPA 110, EPA emissions, and company safety policies
.


Track 
fuel consumption, runtime hours, and spare parts inventory
.




5. Installation & Commissioning Support




Assist in 
new generator installations, ATS setups, and synchronization checks
.


Verify proper operation before handover to operations.




Job Requirements








High school diploma or equivalent
 (required).


Technical certification
 in Electrical/Mechanical Engineering, Generator Maintenance, or related field (preferred).


Manufacturer certifications
 (Cummins, Kohler, Caterpillar, Generac) are a plus.


3+ years
 of hands-on experience in 
generator maintenance and repair
.


Familiarity with 
diesel/gas generators (10kVA – 2000kVA+)
.


Knowledge of 
ATS, load banks, and paralleling systems
.


Mechanical:
 Engine diagnostics (compression tests, fuel system troubleshooting). Ability to disassemble, repair, and reassemble generator components.


Electrical:
 Proficiency with 
multimeters, meggers, and diagnostic tools
. Understanding of 
control panels, wiring diagrams, and synchronization
.


Soft Skills:
 Strong problem-solving and attention to detail. Ability to work independently and under pressure. Good communication for reporting and team coordination.


Field Work:
 On-site servicing at multiple locations.


Physical Demands:
 Lifting (25 kg), working in confined spaces, outdoor repairs.


Shift Work:
 Rotational on-call duty for emergencies.


Travel to all sites for repair and maintenance works.

28798.description:
Summary










Acting as the project's leader on the ground, the point of contact for workers, subcontractors, and any site visitors. 






Site Manager is responsible for the overall execution and delivery of all aspects of project execution, ensuring efficient site operations and construction quality in accordance with approved designs, quality standards and project schedules.






The role should prioritize 
strong hands-on construction execution, workforce leadership, cost discipline, safety management, and the ability to resolve technical and operational problems independently
.






Duties and Responsibilities






1. Site Operations & Projects Executions 
- Oversee daily construction activities and ensure projects schedules and milestones are met.
- Lead and supervise site personnel, subcontractors, and construction teams to achieve productivity targets.
- Monitor workforce performance, discipline, and resolve on-site technical and operational issues to minimize delays and disruptions.
- Track construction progress, identify critical delays, and implement corrective actions.


2. Manpower & Resource Management
- Allocate manpower, equipment, and resources efficiently according to project requirements.
- Maintain safe and organised inventory storage on sites to reduce shrinkage from theft, misplacement, or weather damage.
- Monitor construction costs, material consumption, labor expenses, and subcontractor claims against project budgets.
- Control material wastage, prevent unnecessary expenditure, and identify cost-saving opportunities.


3. Safety, Health & Environmental Compliance
- Enforce site safety standards, occupational health requirements, and environmental protection practices.
- Conduct regular site inspections, safety briefings, and risk assessments to prevent accidents and unsafe working conditions.
- Ensure proper site housekeeping, waste management, and compliance with applicable safety and environmental regulations.


4. Design, Technical & 
Quality Assurance
- Ensure construction works comply with approved architectural, structural, and M&E drawings, technical specifications, and building regulations.
- Coordinate with consultants, engineers, and authorities to resolve design discrepancies and obtain necessary technical approvals.
- Monitor construction quality at every stage, from foundation and structural works to architectural finishes and final handover.
- Implement inspection procedures and ensure defects and non-conformance issues are rectified promptly.


5. Project Coordination & Progress Reporting
- Act as the first point of contact for project stakeholders and site visitors to resolve project-related matters.
- Conduct regular site meetings to monitor progress, address issues, and coordinate tasks.
- Prepare regular progress reports covering site performance, manpower, costs, safety, technical issues, and project risks.






Job Requirements








Degree in Construction Management, Civil Engineering, or related field.


7-10 years experience in managing successful project construction.


Proven track record of full-lifecycle and strong hands-on construction execution.


Strong understanding of construction processes, materials, and legal regulations.


Excellent organizational and leadership abilities.


Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills.


Proficient in project management software and tools.


First aid training and health and safety qualifications relevant to the construction industry.


Ability to work under pressure and handle multiple tasks.


Strong documentation and analytical skills in preparing regular site reporting updates.




Others






The role will be based on the project site and must be prepared to deal with all the physical conditions of an active construction environment. This includes exposure to various weather conditions, noise, and dust. The role may involve standing for long periods and some heavy lifting. Safety is of utmost importance, so the manager will always be expected to wear appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE) and ensure that all site personnel adhere to safety protocols. The job may require working outside of standard office hours, including weekends and evenings, to meet project demands or to address any urgent issues that arise.


Indoor and outdoor, and adapt to changing weather conditions.


May need to travel between different sites and office when required.

28796.description:
Summary






The Senior Mechanic specializing in Heavy Equipment is responsible for maintaining, repairing, and optimizing a wide range of heavy machinery used in construction, mining, and other industrial sectors. This role requires extensive knowledge of heavy equipment mechanics, hydraulics, and electronics, along with a commitment to safety and efficiency.


Duties and Responsibilities








Conduct regular maintenance and repair on heavy equipment such as bulldozers, cranes, excavators, and loaders.


Diagnose and troubleshoot mechanical issues including hydraulic, pneumatic, and electrical systems.


Perform complex repairs and component replacements, ensuring equipment operates efficiently and safely.


Lead and mentor junior mechanics in repair techniques and preventive maintenance of heavy machinery.


Oversee the maintenance records and inventory of parts and supplies for heavy equipment.


Collaborate with equipment operators to understand equipment issues and provide effective solutions.


Stay updated with the latest technological advancements in heavy machinery and repair techniques.


Ensure compliance with all safety guidelines and regulations during maintenance and repair operations.


Coordinate with the management team to plan and schedule maintenance activities and minimize equipment downtime.


Provide emergency repair service as needed to prevent delays in project timelines.




Job Requirements








Advanced diploma or equivalent in mechanics, heavy equipment maintenance, or related field.


Minimum of 5 years of experience in heavy equipment repair and maintenance.


In-depth knowledge of heavy equipment systems, including hydraulic, electronic, and engine components.


Proficiency in using diagnostic tools and equipment for heavy machinery.


Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently or as part of a team.


Strong communication skills to effectively guide and mentor team members.


Commitment to maintaining a safe work environment, with knowledge of OSHA safety standards.


Physical ability to handle heavy equipment and work in various environmental conditions.


Flexibility to respond to emergency repair requests outside of standard working hours.




Others






Joining our team as a Senior Mechanic specializing in Heavy Equipment offers a challenging yet rewarding career path, where you will be instrumental in ensuring the functionality and reliability of critical machinery. We value dedication, skill, and a strong work ethic, and provide opportunities for continuous learning and career advancement.

28795.description:
Summary






The Housekeeping Team Leader will supervise and lead a team of housekeeping staff within a property managed by the company. The role focuses on maintaining the cleanliness and appearance of residential and commercial properties, ensuring that all cleaning tasks are completed efficiently and to the highest standards. The position does not require advanced administrative skills or formal educational qualifications but relies heavily on experience and practical knowledge in property housekeeping operations.


Duties and Responsibilities








Team Leadership:




Lead and support a team of housekeeping staff in daily operations across the property.


Assign cleaning tasks and inspect completed work to ensure high standards of cleanliness and presentation.


Train and guide team members on cleaning procedures and the proper use of cleaning equipment and materials.


Foster a positive and cooperative working environment, addressing any team-related issues effectively.






Quality Control:




Conduct regular inspections of residential units, common areas, and external property spaces to ensure they meet cleanliness standards.


Promptly address any cleanliness issues or discrepancies identified during inspections.






Operational Support:




Assist with cleaning tasks as necessary, including but not limited to cleaning common areas, restocking supplies, and performing deep cleaning projects.


Report any maintenance or safety issues to the Property Manager or appropriate department for resolution.


Ensure that cleaning supplies and equipment are managed effectively and are in good working order.






Resident and Tenant Interaction:




Respond to resident and tenant requests regarding cleanliness or housekeeping services in a timely and professional manner.


Ensure a high level of satisfaction among residents and tenants by maintaining cleanliness and addressing any concerns promptly.






Communication:




Communicate daily operations, staff performance, and any challenges to the Property Manager or Housekeeping Supervisor.


Relay important information and updates to the housekeeping staff.








Job Requirements








Proven experience in a housekeeping role, preferably within a property management or similar setting, with at least 2-3 years in a supervisory or team leader capacity.




Strong practical knowledge of housekeeping operations, including cleaning techniques specific to residential and commercial properties.




Ability to lead and motivate a team with a hands-on approach to leadership.


Strong attention to detail and commitment to maintaining high cleanliness standards across all property areas.


Good communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to interact effectively with residents, tenants, and team members.


Ability to work efficiently under pressure and manage multiple tasks.


No formal education qualifications are required; however, relevant experience in housekeeping is essential.




Others




Physical Demands




Ability to perform physical tasks such as standing for long periods, lifting, bending, and cleaning.


Willingness to work flexible hours, including weekends and holidays, as required.


The role involves working across residential and commercial properties managed by the company, with the majority of time spent on-site overseeing and assisting with housekeeping tasks.

28770.description:
Job Type:
 
Permanent
 
About us 


K92 Mining Limited are the owners the high-grade Kainantu Gold Mine in Eastern Highlands Province. Since commencing operations in 2016, we have delivered consistent production growth. More importantly, we have contributed significantly to the economy of Papua New Guinea, more than 90% of our employees and contractors are from PNG and our local education and skills development initiatives which include scholarships, traineeships and adult literacy programs continue to bring significant benefit the communities in which we operate. 


We are now transforming the operation with a new 1.2 mtpa process plant as well as extensive construction and expansion across site that will see us triple the output from our mine by 2027. In addition to our ongoing production success, we have an extensive exploration programme across our highly prospective tenement, making K92 a great place to build a long-term career.


About the role


Responsible for the support and supervision of the Asset Protection Department and for advising the K92 Management Team on all matters regarding security and asset protection and other related issues.


Key Accountabilities


Key accountabilities of this position include.




Providing supervision and oversight of all security management systems, including Assets Protection staff, contracted security guards and government security forces deployed to site.


Conduct security risk assessments and develop operations action plans to hold accountable team members for outcomes.


Develop and implement security improvement programs; to include detailed work and budget plans, procedures, training, and assessment tools to enhance security at all sites.


Maintain timely communications with Senior Management of incidents or developments that may result in personal injuries, interference with operations or that may cause property loss.




About You 


To be considered for this role, it is essential that you have a university degree/diploma in in Security & Risk Management or you have Police or Military training background. You must have a strong leadership and decision-making skills with good interpersonal and negotiating skills. In addition to this, you will have some or all the following.




Minimum 10 years’ experience in security, law enforcement or military operations


Minimum 7 years Management or Supervision experience in security operations with multi facet teams in resource or industrial sectors


Site security experience in the extractive industries (Mining, Oil & Gas)


Possess strong influencing and negotiation skills and the ability to develop and maintain constructive relationships with management, team members, peers, police, and other external agencies.




Life at K92  


K92 is an Equal Opportunity Employer, our commitment is to respect the rights of every individual to work to their highest potential, free from discrimination.  Our values of Collaboration, Accountability, Respect for others, Excellence and Safety are at the core of everything we do, and they are the foundation upon which our success has been built.


Our camp is well managed and provides residents with good, healthy meals made from locally sourced fresh produce as well as internet, cable tv and a gymnasium.


At K92, we want all employees to share in our success, so as well as a competitive salary, employees also participate in our long- and short-term incentive plans, we also provide employees with access to savings incentive programs, medical assistance and the option to salary sacrifice for certain expenses.


In addition to all of this, employees can also access our Wellbeing and employee assistance programs whilst working a friendly roster. 


THIS POSITION IS OPEN ONLY TO CANDIDATES WHO HAVE THE RIGHT TO LIVE & WORK IN PNG WITHOUT SPONSORSHIP

We are now transforming the operation with a new 1.2 mtpa process plant as well as extensive construction and expansion across site that will see us triple the output from our mine by 2027. In addition to our ongoing production success, we have an extensive exploration programme across our highly prospective tenement, making K92 a great place to build a long-term career.


About the role


Joining our underground mining team, you will provide comprehensive training in safe mining practices as well as all types of mining heavy equipment within the underground mining environment. In this role you will assess operator competencies to ensure they meet the required standards and issue appropriate licences.


Key Accountabilities


Key accountabilities of this position include.




Teach classroom and practical, hands-on field sessions on underground equipment (such as trucks, jumbos, bolters, and LHD loaders) and mining processes.


Educate workers on hazard identification, risk assessment, emergency response, and site safety procedures.


Conduct evaluations, verifications of competency (VOC), and workplace observations to sign off on operator clearances.


Assist in creating lesson plans, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and training materials.


Maintain accurate, up-to-date attendance and training progression records.


Coach and mentor new hires, contractors, and transitioning


Provide, maintain, and improve underground mining employee's competency levels through training and assessment.


Carry out inductions to personnel as required and assist in onboarding of personal.


Facilitate training on all heavy equipment and ensure that all underground personal and comply to the site approved training programs.


Organise allocated training for trainees.


Present Power Point training presentations.


Conduct a final competency check of all operators before authorising issue of Licence.


Provide necessary training in site standards and SOP’s.


Manage the delivery of training programs to K92 employees in accordance with training outcomes and agreed objectives


Actively promotes a safe and healthy culture.


Demonstrates personal responsibility for own health and safety whilst setting clear example to others.


Perform general housekeeping within and around responsible work area.


Ensure Training & Development is conducted in a safe manner and in accordance with established procedures.




About You 


To be considered for this role, it is essential that you




Possess minimum of Grade 10 education.


Prior experience as a supervisor.


Prior experience as a trainer is essential.


Must have Certificate IV in Workplace Training TRA40B Certificate 4 in Training and Assessment or equivalent.


A minimum of 7 years’ experience in underground mining as a miner / operator.


Previous certificates in operating underground mining equipment


Must have a current PNG Class 6 Drivers licence.


Be able to provide current police clearance


Strong interpersonal, written and oral communication skills in English.


Well-developed computer skills.


Good planning & organizational skills with ability to manage multiple responsibilities and the self-discipline to achieve tasks on time with minimal supervision.


Able to accept authority and discipline.

28628.description:
LEGAL SCHOLARSHIP 2027


Calling all Third-Year Law Students at UPNG!


New Porgera Limited (NPL) invites applications from Papua New Guinean citizens currently in their third year of study for a Bachelor of Laws (LLB) at the University of Papua New Guinea (UPNG) to apply for the New Porgera Limited Legal Scholarship.


                                                     






ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA


To be eligible, applicants must:




Be a Papua New Guinean citizen currently studying at UPNG for a law degree. 


submit an essay on the topic set out in Part 2. below together with your curriculum vitae (include three referees with contact details);


Be of good standing and repute in the community.


Submit an updated academic transcript; and


Submit the essay and all accompanying documents 
by 24
th
 December 2026. 
Hard copies will not be accepted.








 


              2. 
ESSAY TOPIC


“Freedom of Contract in Papua New Guinea: Its Scope, Limitations and the Role of Fairness”


The principle of freedom of contract holds that parties should be free to determine the terms of their own agreements.  Critically discuss the extent to which Papua New Guinean law respects this principle and the circumstances in which it is justifiably limited.   In your essay, consider statutory interventions (such as the 
Fairness of Transactions Act 
1993) and the doctrine of unconscionability and evaluate whether the law achieves an appropriate balance between protecting weaker parties and preserving freedom of contract in Papua New Guinea. 




Word limit: 2,500–3,000 words


Referencing: Use proper reference




 


JUDGING 


The Judging Panel comprises of:






Ms Sumassy Singin – Deputy Dean of Planning, UPNG School of Law






Ms Cathy Magalu – General Manager – Corporate Services, Kumul Minerals Holdings Ltd






Ms Karo Maha – Country Manager, New Porgera Ltd






Ms Ethel Heagi – Head of Legal, New Porgera Ltd


 






SELECTION PROCESS


Shortlisted candidates will be contacted and invited to participate in an interview with the Judging Panel before the final decision is made.


The decision of the Judging Panel is final.


APPLICATION DEADLINE - 
24 December 2026


If you do not hear from New Porgera Limited within three (14) days following the closing date, please consider your application unsuccessful for this opportunity.


Take the opportunity to demonstrate your legal knowledge, critical thinking and understanding of the Papua New Guinean legal system.


New Porgera Limited – Investing in Papua New Guinea’s Future Legal Professionals.





    	        
Apply

Love seeing your drawings come to life? Come build with us.
Port Moresby | Full-time


Atlas is growing, and we'd love to welcome an experienced Draftsman or Architect to our team. You'll help design Steel Haus modular homes, structural steel and construction projects across Papua New Guinea.


At Atlas, you won't just draw it and hand it over. You'll work alongside the people who fabricate and build it, and you'll see your work take shape in our workshop and on site.


WHAT YOU'LL DO




Create architectural, structural and steel fabrication drawings, from first concept to finished building.


Prepare shop drawings, fabrication details and material take-offs for our workshop.


Put together drawings and documents for building permits and approvals.


Help make sure every design is practical, buildable and meets code.


Work closely with our estimating, engineering, workshop and site teams to keep projects moving.




ABOUT YOU


You have 3–5 years' drafting or design experience, strong AutoCAD skills and a relevant qualification in Architecture, Drafting, Building Design or similar. Steel detailing experience is a must. Revit, ArchiCAD, 3D modelling or modular construction experience is a big plus. Most of all, you take pride in getting the details right.


WHY YOU'LL ENJOY WORKING HERE


We design it, detail it, fabricate it and build it, all under one roof. You'll join a friendly, growing PNG team and see your drawings become real homes and structures in communities across the country.
